description: Self-driving event dispatcher grain (Orleans cluster singleton, reminder-driven) with per-handler retry, dead letter table, and best-effort producer trigger — restores at-least-once delivery to all ICloudEventHandler subscriptions.

tasks.title: DeadLetters table model, migration, and dead letter store
tasks.description: Add the DeadLetterRow entity (17 columns) registered as DbSet<DeadLetterRow> in MohistDbContext with OnModelCreating configuration and a clean EF migration AddDeadLettersTable that creates the DeadLetters table + indexes on DeadLetteredAt and (FailingHandler, DeadLetteredAt). Implement IDeadLetterStore (WriteAsync, ListByHandlerAsync, ListByTimeRangeAsync, RetryAsync) backed by IDbContextFactory<MohistDbContext>, where RetryAsync re-nulls DispatchedAt on the source event row identified by (Origin, Source, Id) and preserves the dead letter entry as historical record. Register IDeadLetterStore in MohistSiloRegistration.
acceptanceCriteria: DeadLetterRow exists in Infrastructure/Data/Events/ with all 17 columns (DeadLetterId, Origin, Source, Id, EventId, Type, Time, SpecVersion, Subject, DataContentType, Data, ExtensionsJson, FailingHandler, AttemptCount, ErrorMessage, ErrorStack, DeadLetteredAt) with correct nullability (Subject and ErrorStack nullable)
DbSet<DeadLetterRow> DeadLetters is registered in MohistDbContext and OnModelCreating configures the table name, column lengths, and indexes on DeadLetteredAt and (FailingHandler, DeadLetteredAt)

dotnet ef migrations add AddDeadLettersTable produces a migration whose Up/Down only creates/drops the DeadLetters table; the regenerated MohistDbContextModelSnapshot converges cleanly with no unexpected diff against the ghost designer snapshots
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and npm test (server) pass

IDeadLetterStore + DeadLetterStore implement WriteAsync (persist full event snapshot + FailingHandler + AttemptCount + ErrorMessage/ErrorStack + DeadLetteredAt from TimeProvider), ListByHandlerAsync (ordered by DeadLetteredAt descending), ListByTimeRangeAsync, and RetryAsync (re-nulls source row DispatchedAt via Origin/Source/Id routing, preserves the dead letter row)
Spec test: a dead letter entry written via the store contains the full event snapshot, failing handler identifier, attempt count, and error message/stack
Spec test: ListByHandlerAsync returns entries for the given handler ordered by DeadLetteredAt descending; ListByTimeRangeAsync returns entries within the range
Spec test: RetryAsync re-nulls the source event row DispatchedAt so it reappears in ListUndeliveredAsync, and the dead letter entry remains in the table (not deleted or modified)
Unit test: DeadLetterStore write/read round-trip via IDbContextFactory fake
tasks.output: DeadLetterRow model, DbSet + OnModelCreating config, AddDeadLettersTable migration, IDeadLetterStore/DeadLetterStore, MohistSiloRegistration registration, spec + unit tests
tasks.notes: The DeadLetters entity already exists as a ghost in three migration .Designer.cs snapshots but is absent from the current ModelSnapshot — the new migration must converge with no unexpected model diff. tasks.title: EventDispatcherGrain — cluster singleton, reminder-driven dispatch cycle with per-handler cross-tick retry
tasks.description: Implement IEventDispatcherGrain (IGrainWithStringKey, IRemindable) with DispatchNowAsync, and EventDispatcherGrain as a cluster singleton keyed by a well-known constant. OnActivateAsync registers a persistent Orleans reminder with EventDispatcherOptions.ReminderPeriod (~1s). ReceiveReminder and DispatchNowAsync both call DispatchCycleAsync: single IEventStore.ListUndeliveredAsync query, serial per-row processing in (Source, Id) order, CloudEvent reconstruction, reflective fan-out to matching IEnumerable<Subscription> via CloudEventTypeMatcher, per-handler cross-tick retry with in-memory Dictionary<(Source,Id), Dictionary<int,HandlerState>> and exponential backoff min(BaseBackoff*2^(n-1), MaxBackoff) governed by TimeProvider. On retry exhaustion write a dead letter via IDeadLetterStore and mark handler DeadLettered. After all handlers resolve (succeed or dead-lettered) call MarkDispatchedAsync(source, id, timeProvider.GetUtcNow()); no-match rows also marked. Add EventDispatcherOptions (ReminderPeriod, BatchSize, MaxAttempts, BaseBackoff, MaxBackoff) and register it + the grain services in MohistSiloRegistration. Extend RecordingEventStore test fake to seed ListUndeliveredAsync results and record MarkDispatchedAsync calls.
acceptanceCriteria: IEventDispatcherGrain (IGrainWithStringKey, IRemindable) with Task DispatchNowAsync() exists in Events/Grains/ (namespace Mohist.Server.Events.Grains)

EventDispatcherGrain is a cluster singleton keyed by a well-known constant string (mirroring RunnerRegistryKeys.Global convention); OnActivateAsync registers a persistent reminder via RegisterOrUpdateReminder using EventDispatcherOptions.ReminderPeriod
ReceiveReminder and DispatchNowAsync both invoke the same DispatchCycleAsync; the grain is NOT [Reentrant] so dispatch cycles do not interleave

DispatchCycleAsync calls IEventStore.ListUndeliveredAsync (single UNION ALL query, ordered by (Source, Id), limited by BatchSize) and processes rows serially; empty result completes with no handler invocation

Per row: reconstructs CloudEvent from stored fields, matches subscriptions via CloudEventTypeMatcher (exact / | / * / prefix.*), invokes each matching DispatchDelegate in turn; non-matching subscriptions skipped; no-match rows are marked delivered

Per-handler cross-tick retry: in-memory state keyed by (Source, Id) + handler index; failed handler increments AttemptCount and sets NextAttemptTime = now + Backoff(AttemptCount); rows in backoff are skipped this tick and retried on a later tick (no Task.Delay/Thread.Sleep blocking the grain call)

Backoff(n) = min(BaseBackoff * 2^(n-1), MaxBackoff); when AttemptCount >= MaxAttempts the handler is written to DeadLetters via IDeadLetterStore with Status = DeadLettered; retry budget is per (row, handler) — handler A failures do not count toward handler B

After all matching handlers for a row are Completed or DeadLettered, MarkDispatchedAsync(source, id, timeProvider.GetUtcNow()) is called and the row's in-memory state is cleared; rows with pending handlers are not marked
All time-dependent logic (DispatchedAt timestamp, backoff NextAttemptTime) uses the injected TimeProvider — no DateTimeOffset.UtcNow or wall-clock access in the dispatch path

EventDispatcherOptions (ReminderPeriod=1s, BatchSize=100, MaxAttempts=5, BaseBackoff=1s, MaxBackoff=30s defaults) is configured from the EventDispatcher config section and registered in MohistSiloRegistration.ConfigureMohistSilo
RecordingEventStore test fake supports seeded ListUndeliveredAsync results and records MarkDispatchedAsync calls for assertions
Spec test: at-least-once — handler invoked, dispatcher crashes (simulated) before MarkDispatchedAsync, row remains DispatchedAt IS NULL, next tick redelivers, handler absorbs idempotently on EventId
Spec test: per-stream FIFO — two rows same Source with Id 5 and 9 are processed and marked in order; handler never observes Id=9 before Id=5
Spec test: transient handler failure retried with increasing delay capped at MaxBackoff; advancing FakeTimeProvider elapses backoff without real-time waits; retry budget is per handler
Spec test: successful delivery marks the row (no longer appears in ListUndeliveredAsync); dead-lettered handler also marks the row; each failing handler gets its own dead letter entry
Spec test: no-match event row is marked delivered with no handler invoked; EventBridge/AgentSubscriptionDispatchHandler receive at-least-once delivery without code changes

Reminder self-healing spec: reminder is registered on activation and fires to drive a dispatch cycle (if reminder firing is unreliable under FakeTimeProvider per design Open Question 1, drive dispatch-logic via DispatchNowAsync and test reminder registration + firing separately)
Unit test: Backoff(n) computation and cap; CloudEventTypeMatcher matching integration with subscription fan-out
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and npm test (server) pass
tasks.output: IEventDispatcherGrain + EventDispatcherGrain, EventDispatcherOptions, MohistSiloRegistration wiring, extended RecordingEventStore fake, spec + unit tests
tasks.notes: The dispatcher is the first real Orleans reminder user — RunnerGrain.ReceiveReminder is a documented no-op. GrainTestConfig already provisions UseInMemoryReminderService + ControllableReminderTable but it has never been exercised by a real reminder-driven grain; verify reminder firing under FakeTimeProvider early (design Open Question 1) — if unreliable, drive dispatch-logic specs via DispatchNowAsync and test the reminder path separately. Placement in Events/Grains/ follows the EpicReconciliationService cross-slice rationale. In-memory retry state is lost on crash (acceptable under at-least-once; budget resets). The grain injects IEventStore, IEnumerable<Subscription>, IDeadLetterStore, TimeProvider, IOptions<EventDispatcherOptions> — all singletons.

tasks.title: Best-effort producer immediate trigger pokes after commit
tasks.description: Wire the three event producers (WorkflowRunStore, IssueGrain/IssueStore, AgentSessionGrain/AgentSessionStore) to call IEventDispatcherGrain.DispatchNowAsync() fire-and-forget after their transaction commits. The call is best-effort: exceptions are swallowed and a lost poke is recovered by the next reminder tick. Correctness never depends on the poke. This is additive — removing the poke never breaks at-least-once delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: The three producers obtain the dispatcher grain via IGrainFactory.GetGrain<IEventDispatcherGrain>(wellKnownKey) and call DispatchNowAsync() fire-and-forget after commit
Exceptions from DispatchNowAsync (grain unavailable, thrown, etc.) are swallowed — the producer transaction result is unaffected
Spec test: immediate trigger lowers latency — a producer poke causes the dispatcher to run a dispatch cycle promptly, processing undelivered rows sooner than waiting for the next reminder tick
Spec test: lost immediate trigger is recovered — when the poke is lost/swallowed, the event row remains DispatchedAt IS NULL and the next reminder tick queries and dispatches it
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and npm test (server) pass
tasks.output: Producer-side DispatchNowAsync poke wiring in the three producers + spec tests
tasks.notes: Prefer a direct IGrainFactory.GetGrain call in the stores (design Open Question 4) — stores already depend on IDbContextFactory, adding IGrainFactory is consistent. Keep the poke strictly additive so removing it never breaks correctness; the reminder is the sole source of truth.
